label: Warm Oak Wood
fact_text: Oak trees can live for hundreds of years, and their sturdy wood makes cozy, strong floors!

label: Cloud Soft Carpet
fact_text: Soft carpets keep your toes warm on chilly mornings and absorb playful footsteps!

label: Playful Terrazzo
fact_text: Terrazzo was invented in Venice by mixing colorful chips of stone into smooth cement!

label: Sky Blue Plaster
fact_text: Light blue walls remind us of the peaceful open sky and help us feel calm and creative!

label: Smooth Mountain Marble
fact_text: Marble is a natural limestone that formed deep under mountains over millions of years!

label: Sunflower Linen
fact_text: Linen is woven from flax plant fibers, making it one of the most breathable fabrics in the world!

label: Emerald Velvet
fact_text: Velvet has tiny standing threads called a 'pile' that give it an ultra-soft, magical sheen!

label: Friendly Red Brick
fact_text: Bricks are baked clay blocks that humans have used to build snug shelters for thousands of years!
